output.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(l.net_amount) - SUM(l.cogs)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
output.explanation: Gross margin % per category is (net amount − COGS) / net amount, calculated from the summed order lines rather than by averaging line percentages. It covers orders dated in 2025 and counts only those flagged as revenue (is_revenue). Shipping fees are not included, since they are recorded per order and not per product line. Results are sorted from highest to lowest margin.
